baselines.alphabetical: the pool in name order, which is the ranking's own tie-break and so the floor any ordering must beat
baselines.evasion_only: the ordered rule with the activity and safety keys removed
baselines.random: shuffle the pool under the declared seed

metrics.inverted_rate: the share of rows where a drug on the ineffective list outranks every drug on the effective list. A wrong answer, not a near miss, and it is reported even when the hit rates look acceptable.

preconditions: The candidate pool contains at least one effective and one ineffective drug for at least one ground-truth row, or nothing can be scored.
The profiles are built from the pinned CARD release, not from a synthetic fixture.
declaration.question: For a resistance profile, does the ranking put drugs that are known to work above drugs the profile defeats?
rules: Rows marked partly_verified in the ground truth are excluded from the primary metric and reported separately. Which rows those are is fixed by the frozen ground truth.

No row may be added, removed or re-labelled after the freeze. A row whose citation turns out to be wrong is recorded as an erratum and the result is reported with and without it, never silently dropped.
A row is scorable only when at least one of its effective or ineffective drugs is in the candidate pool. Unscorable rows are counted and named, not skipped quietly.
Every baseline is run on the same pool and the same rows as the method.
The metric set above is complete. A metric not listed here may be reported as an observation but never as the headline.
Every attempt is reported, including runs that failed or were abandoned.
A negative result stands. If the method does not beat the alphabetical baseline, that is the finding.

uncertainty.note: With 6 rows the interval will be very wide. That is the honest result for this sample size and is not to be narrowed by adding rows after seeing it.
